greetings.text:
This greeting isn't an ad.
Neither is the next one.

No ad louder than your song.
Your ears can unclench now.

No AI DJ here.
You're the DJ. Act like it.

No family plan asking
for your home address.

No audiobooks in your music app.
Read like a normal person.

Same song 40 times?
No algorithm to blame this time.

This app has never once
asked for your card.

Ad-free from day one.
Not 'first 3 months free'.

'Still listening?'
Obviously. Rude question.

No podcast host
trying to sell you a mattress.

No price hike email coming.
There's no price to hike.

No green app judging you.
Just Minim, judging you.

Built in Assam.
No boardroom approved this greeting.

Don't tell the other apps,
but you're my favourite.

Ad 1 of 2? Never heard of her.
Just press play.

No 'Skip ad in 5...'
The only skips here are yours.

Their price went up again.
Ours is still zero.

Loyal for five years?
Enjoy your price hike. Not here.

'We're raising prices
because we love you.' Sure, Jan.

Their CEO got a bonus.
You got a price hike.

Shuffle that loops the same
12 songs? We call that a bug.

'Smart' shuffle added a song
you've never liked. Genius.

Music app, podcast app,
book app, mall. Pick one.

No audiobook ad
in the middle of your chorus.

Lyrics behind a paywall?
Here they're just lyrics.

Offline mode for a monthly fee?
Here it's just a button.

Background play as a 'perk'?
Here it's called 'playing'.

6 skips an hour?
Skip all you want. I'm not your boss.

No 'Listening on another device'
kicking you out mid-chorus.

Recap once a year?
Yours comes every single day.

No AI DJ talking over
the best part of the song.

No robot voice saying
'Up next: a vibe.'

No 'Try 3 months free'
that means 'forget to cancel'.

Cancelling takes 9 screens there.
Here there's nothing to cancel.

No student plan that wants
your college ID. Again.

No 'Upgrade' button
glowing like a hazard light.

No ad for premium
while you already pay for premium.

No ad for the app
you're already using.

No redesign that moved
every button you liked.

No vertical video feed
in your music app. Breathe.

Your data isn't the product.
The music is.

No server saw your 3 AM songs.
Only your phone did.

Their 'daily mix'?
The same 30 songs in a hat.

Sponsored song in your queue?
That's an ad in disguise.

No label paid to be
your 'personalised' pick.

No login wall
between you and your song.

No account, no password reset
email at 2 AM. Bliss.

No 'Rate us 5 stars'
popup mid-chorus.

No notification saying
'Your mix misses you.'

No alert about a podcast
you'll never listen to.

100 million songs
and they still play the same one.

One sad song and their app
makes you a 'Heartbreak Mix'.

No 30-second preview
pretending to be a song.

No 'Upgrade to see lyrics'.
They're right there. Sing.

Bundled with a video plan
you never asked for? Not here.

Lite, Plus, Max, Ultra?
We have one plan: free.

No quarterly earnings call
about your listening habits.

No 'Your free trial ends
in 3 days'. Relax.

Other apps: 'Upgrade now!'
Minim: 'Play now.'

Other apps sell your taste.
I just roast it.

Other apps have a growth team.
I have a greetings file.

No marketing team wrote this.
You can tell.

Somewhere a music app just
added its fourth podcast tab.

The giants want your wallet.
I just want your ears.

No ad for a game
you'll uninstall in a minute.

No 'Sign in to continue'.
You were already continuing.

Their 'smart' playlist
has never met you.

No feature 'available
in select markets only'.

No auto-renew
ambush on the 1st.

Somewhere a 'Go Premium' banner
is crying. Let it.

Their app needs 300 MB.
I'm about 8. Just saying.

I don't judge your music.
I just remember all of it.

Your neighbours called.
They want the bass back.

Your taste is great.
Mostly. We'll talk.

Your music, your rules.
I just keep the receipts.

Skipping songs is cardio.
Kind of.

{name}! Finally.
The songs were getting bored.

Skipped 3 songs to find
the one you always play.

400 liked songs.
You play 7 of them.

Your taste is valid.
Not saying good. Valid.

Another playlist called 'vibes'?
Bold. Original. Iconic.

You call it a playlist.
I call it a cry for help.

Main character music
for a walk to the fridge.

Romanticising the bus ride
again, aren't you?

Your 'chill' playlist
has never once been chill.

You skip the intro
of a song you love. Why?

Volume at 100?
Your ears filed a complaint.

Air drums detected.
You missed the beat. Twice.

Wrong lyrics, full confidence.
Honestly? Iconic.

Your shower concerts
have sold zero tickets.

Sad songs while perfectly fine?
Classic you.

You queued 40 songs
for a 10-minute walk.

Opened Minim, stared at Home.
A whole mood.

You don't have a type.
You have one artist on loop.

Your queue is 90% songs
you'll skip later.

You pressed play
then opened five other apps.

That song you hate-listen to?
I saw that.

Earbuds at 5%.
You at 100% denial.

Liked it ironically?
The heart button can't tell.

Too popular for you now?
Okay, hipster.

Headphones in, ignoring everyone.
Respect.

{name}, your taste is elite.
Your skips? Less so.

{name}, the playlist
won't curate itself.

Hi {name}.
Your aux privileges are under review.

{name}, you're the DJ.
Please not that one again.

Welcome back, {name}.
The repeat button missed you.

{name}, we need to talk
about your 2 AM queue.

Look, {name}.
Not every song needs a replay.

{name} has entered the chat.
Volume: questionable.

{name}, drink some water.
Then hit play.

Oh, {name}.
That song again? Of course.

{name}, you're one skip
away from greatness.

One more song.
It's never just one.

Warning: may cause
sudden air guitar.

Today's forecast:
100% chance of bangers.

Silence is golden.
Gold is overrated. Press play.

Nobody:
You: one more song.

POV: you opened Minim and
spent 20 minutes choosing.

This is fine.
The queue is on fire.

Task failed successfully:
slept through 3 albums.

I am once again asking
you to press play.

One does not simply
play just one song.

Sir, this is a music app.
Please press play.

Ight, imma head out.
Kidding. I live here.

We have music at home.
The music at home: bangers.

It's giving
headphones-on energy.

Hear me out:
more music.

Vibe check:
passed. Barely.

Living rent free
in your headphones.

Main character energy
loading...

Let him cook.
Him = the playlist.

Touch grass?
After this song.

It's not a phase, mom.
It's a playlist.

Caught in 4K
singing off-key.

Skill issue?
No, skip issue.

Emotional damage:
the song ended.

Chat, is this real?
No ads? Real.

Change my mind:
the bridge is the best part.

Brain: sleep.
Also brain: one more album.

Me and the boys
playing one song on repeat.

Discover has new shelves.
Go on, judge them.

Discover picked songs for you.
No marketer was consulted.

Lyrics light up word by word.
No more mumbling the verse.

Tap any lyric line
to jump right to it.

Song in another language?
The translation's right under it.

No lyrics for that song?
Gemini can listen and write them.

Gemini lyrics say they're AI.
No gaslighting here.

Falling asleep to music?
The sleep timer has your back.

Save it offline.
Tunnels can't stop you now.

Bass boost: Heavy.
Neighbours: furious.

Track fade on.
Songs melt into each other.

Quiet song?
Volume boost. Say less.

Drag songs in Up next.
You're the boss of the queue.

The radio keeps going
after your song ends. Like me.

Tapes turn channels into audio.
No video eating your data.

Tapes remember where you stopped.
Unlike your group chat.

Tapes at 2x speed?
Lecture speedrun. Nerd.

Your streak lives in Stats.
Don't let it die tonight.

Your daily recap has a roast.
Brace yourself.

Guess your top song
in the recap. Easy, right?

Your listening personality
is in the recap. Yikes.

Share your recap card.
Flex responsibly.

Ask Gemini to roast your taste.
Bring tissues.

Ask Gemini for a playlist.
You just press play.

Import your playlists.
Leave the old app on read.

Backups go to your folder.
Not our cloud. We have none.

Two phones, one folder.
Your likes sync themselves.

Clear history wipes
your 3 AM secrets. Everywhere.

Festival themes bring
their own wallpaper. Fancy.

Dynamic colours on.
The album cover sets the mood.

Heart a song.
Watch it burst. Satisfying.

Artist pages have Shuffle.
Live a little.

Every repeat-one loop counts.
Yes, I'm counting.

On repeat knows
what you did this week.

'Not interested'?
That song is dead to us.

Search your playlists
from the pill in Library.

Your profile photo
never leaves this phone.

Lyrics in full screen.
Karaoke night is back on.

Hid a song by accident?
'Not interested' has Undo now.

'Because you like' on Discover.
I was paying attention.

Forgotten favourites:
songs you ghosted. Call them.

Skip a song early
and the radio takes the hint.
